Contributing to trainingmodels

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in contributing. The package is in early development, so please open an issue before starting any work.

Reporting bugs

Open an issue using the Bug report template. Include a minimal reproducible example (for instance with the reprex package) and the output of sessionInfo().

Proposing a new method

Open an issue using the New method proposal template. Every proposal must give the primary reference in which the formula was published. Methods are only implemented after the formula has been verified against that source.

Pull requests

  • Link the pull request to an existing issue.
  • Write code from the verified formula. Third-party code may be used as an external reference for tests, but must never be copied into the package.
  • Document the formula, its source and its limitations with roxygen2 (markdown syntax).
  • Add tests with testthat (3rd edition), including at least one numerical test against a published or reference value.
  • Make sure devtools::check() passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  • Disclose any AI assistance in the pull request description.
  • Code, documentation and commit messages are written in English.

Code of Conduct

Please note that this project is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By contributing to this project you agree to abide by its terms.
